VISUALIZATION¶

In [ ]:
#plotting the variance of each component and cummulatative variance
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,6))
ax.bar(np.arange(1, no_pca+1, 1), pca.explained_variance_ratio_, label='Variance')
ax.set_xticks(np.arange(1, no_pca+1, 1))
ax.set_xlabel('Principal Components')
ax.set_ylabel('Explained Variance')
#cummulatative variance line plotting
ax2 = ax.twinx()
ax2.plot(range(1, no_pca+1), cumm_var_ratio, color='red', marker='o', linestyle='--', label='Cumulative Variance')
ax2.set_xticks
ax2.set_ylabel('Cummulative Explained Variance')
lines, labels = ax.get_legend_handles_labels()
lines2, labels2 = ax2.get_legend_handles_labels()
ax.legend(lines + lines2, labels + labels2, loc='center right')
plt.show()

ax.set_yticklabels(np.arange(1,no_pca+1))
plt.ylabel('Projection vectors, $p_j$')
plt.show()

X_train shape: (48, 3)

In [ ]:
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
#Fitting in the linear regression model
lr = LinearRegression()
lr_model = lr.fit(X_train, Y_train)
In [ ]:
#Calculating the residuals for each feature variable
residuals_train_all = {}
residuals_test_all = {}
for i, column in enumerate(Y_train.columns):
    residuals_train = Y_train[column] - lr_model.predict(X_train)[:, i]
    residuals_train_all[column] = residuals_train
for i, column in enumerate(Y_test.columns):
    residuals_test = Y_test[column] - lr_model.predict(X_test)[:, i]
    residuals_test_all[column] = residuals_test

VISUALIZATION¶

In [ ]:
#Plotting the residuals for each feature variable
for column in residuals_train_all:
    plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
    plt.plot(range(len(residuals_train_all[column])), residuals_train_all[column], linestyle='-', c='b',alpha=0.5)
    plt.plot(range(len(residuals_test_all[column])), residuals_test_all[column], linestyle='-', color='r')
    plt.title(f'Residuals for {column} - Training and Test Set')
    plt.xlabel('Index')
    plt.ylabel('Residuals')
    plt.legend(['train','test'])
    plt.show()
In [ ]:
#Residuals Vs Probability density function histogram graph
for column in residuals_train_all:
    plt.hist(residuals_train_all[column], density=True, color='g', alpha=0.5, label='Train')
    plt.hist(residuals_test_all[column], density=True, color='b', alpha=0.3, label='Test')
    plt.legend()
    plt.xlabel('Residuals')
    plt.ylabel('PDF')
    plt.title(f'Residuals Distribution for {column}')
    plt.show()
In [ ]:
#Plotting true response vs predicted response
for column in Y_train.columns:
    plt.scatter(lr_model.predict(X_train)[:, i], Y_train[column], c='g', alpha=0.4, label=f'Train', edgecolors='k')
    plt.scatter(lr_model.predict(X_test)[:, i], Y_test[column], c='b', label=f'Test', edgecolors='k')
    plt.xlabel('True Response')
    plt.ylabel('Predicted Response')
    plt.legend()
    plt.title(f'True Response vs Predicted Response for {column}')
    min_val = min(lr_model.predict(X_train)[:, i].min(), Y_train[column].min(), lr_model.predict(X_test)[:, i].min(), Y_test[column].min())
    max_val = max(lr_model.predict(X_train)[:, i].max(), Y_train[column].max(), lr_model.predict(X_test)[:, i].max(), Y_test[column].max())
    plt.xlim(min_val, max_val)
    plt.ylim(min_val, max_val)
    plt.plot([min_val, max_val], [min_val, max_val], linestyle='--', color='red', label='45-degree line')
    plt.show()

EVALUATION¶

In [ ]:
#calculating the R-squared value for training and test datasets
from sklearn.metrics import r2_score
y_train_pred = lr_model.predict(X_train)
y_test_pred = lr_model.predict(X_test)
r2_train = r2_score(Y_train, y_train_pred)
r2_test = r2_score(Y_test, y_test_pred)
print(f'R-squared (Training Set): {r2_train}')
print(f'R-squared (Test Set): {r2_test}')

R-squared (Training Set): 0.6903402855387126
R-squared (Test Set): 0.7005950036560267
In [ ]:
#Evaluation metrics for Linear Regression
from sklearn import metrics
mae=metrics.mean_absolute_error(Y_test, lr_model.predict(X_test))
mse=metrics.mean_squared_error(Y_test, lr_model.predict(X_test))
rmse=np.sqrt(mse)
r2_square=metrics.r2_score(Y_test, lr_model.predict(X_test))
print(f'MAE: {mae:.3f}')
print(f'MSE: {mse:.3f}')
print(f'RMSE: {rmse:.3f}')
print(f'R Square: {r2_square:.3f}')
